Name: TornDeck
Author: Callz

Actions.Name: Stats Indicator
Actions.Tooltip: Live Torn.com stat bars with an unread notification badge.

Actions.Name: Flight Status
Actions.Tooltip: Shows your current Torn.com flight progress and time left, and flashes when you land.

Actions.Name: Notifications
Actions.Tooltip: Unread event/message/award/competition count. Flashes until you press it to dismiss.

Actions.Name: Chain
Actions.Tooltip: Live chain count and countdown. Flashes once it's close to dropping, by a threshold you set.

Actions.Name: Hospital
Actions.Tooltip: Live hospital release countdown. Flashes once you're close to release, by a threshold you set.

Actions.Name: Cooldowns
Actions.Tooltip: Live drug/booster/medical cooldown countdown - pick which one in the settings. Flashes when ready.

Actions.Name: Refills
Actions.Tooltip: Shows whether today's free energy/nerve refill has been used - pick which one in the settings. Flashes while still available.

Description: Live Torn.com stats, flight tracking, chain/hospital/cooldown/refill alerts, and notifications on your Stream Deck. Unofficial fan-made tool - not affiliated with Torn.com.
